title: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is live on OpenPak
body: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is live on OpenPak, and its online play is open to players now. Matchmaking works, so you can find a room and play against other people. Pick any of the 51 classic games and challenge someone online.
footer: OpenPak Clubhouse Games — playable, not promised.
